$comment: Advisories accepted after assessing exposure in this application.
Each entry needs a reason and a reviewOn date. An expired entry fails the
build, so accepted risk gets revisited instead of quietly accumulating.
Anything not listed here still fails CI at high severity.

allow.reason: sharp reaches us only as an optional dependency of Next.js, used for next/image optimization. The application never renders next/image and serves one static logo, so no image ever passes through libvips at runtime. The published fix requires Next.js 16, a major upgrade that is out of scope for this change.
Nested inside Next.js at a pinned version. PostCSS runs at build time over our own Tailwind stylesheets; no attacker-controlled CSS is ever processed. Fixing it requires Next.js 16.
Same nested Next.js PostCSS. The sourceMappingURL read needs attacker-controlled CSS input, which never reaches the build.
